# Fiordland Linux

> Fiordland Linux is a free, open-source, Arch-based Linux distribution. It ships a stable channel built from tested Arch Linux snapshots, the CachyOS kernel, Btrfs with automatic snapper snapshots before every update, Flathub, and gaming packages (Steam, Proton-CachyOS, MangoHud, gamescope) out of the box. It has its own tools, named after birds of the Fiordland region of New Zealand.

## Tools

- [tawaki](https://github.com/Fiordland-Linux/tawaki): command-line package manager in Rust. One command for the Arch repos, Flathub and the AUR, picking the cleanest source.
- [kuaka](https://github.com/Fiordland-Linux/kuaka): graphical update manager for system, AUR and Flatpak updates, with a snapshot first.
- [weka](https://github.com/Fiordland-Linux/weka): switches desktops and window managers cleanly while keeping apps, logins and passwords.
- [rawaru](https://github.com/Fiordland-Linux/rawaru): graphical installer with 24 desktops and window managers and optional dotfiles.
- crest: Fiordland's own Hyprland shell, forked from Caelestia.
